input.title: Women's Outdoorsy – Outdoorsy in Theory Cropped Hoodie
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

Outdoorsy in theory: a cropped pullover for the woman who owns the hiking boots and camps three steps from the back door.

OUTDOORSY in heavy serif capitals sits above a vintage backyard scene, a dome tent on the lawn with an orange extension cord running in from the open back door, a glowing lamp inside, a fluffy slipper by the flap, a steaming mug on a folding stool, a cat on the doorstep and a string of patio lights, with IN THEORY. underneath. Cream and mustard lettering on both Black and Storm. A soft cropped hoodie for the patio campout, the first cold morning and every weekend trip that ends before the Wi-Fi does, and an easy gift for the friend who owns all the gear. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Cropped body with a raw hem and a dropped shoulder cut
  • 52% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton, 48% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 6.5 oz/yd²
  • Dyed-to-match drawstrings
  • Sizes S–2XL
  • 2 colors: Black and Storm
  • Blank product sourced from Mexico, Nicaragua or the United States

Questions

How long is this cropped hoodie, and how does it fit?
The Outdoorsy in Theory cropped hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Bella+Canvas 7502 with a cropped body, a raw hem and a dropped shoulder. It sits at the waist or just above, so it layers over a tee or a tank, and the roomy shoulders keep it relaxed rather than tight.

What is the cropped pullover made of, and is it warm?
It is 52% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton and 48% polyester fleece at 6.5 oz per square yard, with dyed-to-match drawstrings. That makes it a light, soft layer for patio evenings, backyard campfires and chilly mornings, warm enough over a tee but not bulky enough to replace a coat.

What size should I order?
Sizes run S through 2XL in a cropped, relaxed cut, so most people order their usual size. Go up one for a roomier, longer feel over a base layer. Graphic Tees Co. gives one free size exchange within 30 days of delivery, and we print the new size without a return.

How do I wash it so the print lasts?
Turn the hoodie inside out, wash in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry low. Skip bleach and do not iron directly on the print. A cropped hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. that arrives misprinted or damaged is reprinted or refunded within 30 days of delivery, so the tent stays rust and sage and the lettering stays crisp.

When should I order it for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 for delivery before Christmas. Graphic Tees Co. prints each Outdoorsy in Theory cropped hoodie to order, which takes a few days before shipping, and US shipping is free on orders of $45 or more. It suits a sister or best friend who owns all the gear and skips the trip.
